projects.title: my contribution to Spindafy
projects.bodyText:
- This is a simple script to find a personality value (PID) that most closely matches a target image when applied as a pattern to the Pokémon Spinda!
 - fix crashing when the image sections are too large for library to handle

projects.title: my contributions to SuperTuxKart
projects.bodyText:
- SuperTuxKart is a free kart racing game. It focuses on fun and not on realistic kart physics. Instructions can be found on the in-game help page.
 - improved speed of skybox generation.
 - fixed compilation failure of server only builds.
 - helped code cleanup of server only builds.

projects.title: my contribution to Duino-Coin
projects.bodyText:
- Simple, eco-friendly, centralized coin that can be mined with Arduinos, ESP boards, Raspberry Pis, computers, and many more (including Wi-Fi routers, smart TVs, smartphones, smartwatches, SBCs and other MCUs)..
 - I added the option to disable Serial printing in the miner which helps with performance.

projects.title: Socratic AI
projects.bodyText:
- An AI designed based on the OpenAI paper Attention Is All You Need.
 - Uses the transformer architecture.
 - trained to learn socratic method though not very good with current hyper-parameters and training data amount.
 - optimized for low memory usage.
